story_text: As a logged-in user, I want to log out so that my session is ended securely.

positive.title: Log out successfully from an active session
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
2. Click the 'Logout' button.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.

positive.title: Log out from multiple devices simultaneously
steps: 1. Log in to the account on Device A with valid email and password.
2. Log in to the same account on Device B with valid email and password.
3. Click the 'Logout' button on Device A.
positive.expected_result: User is logged out from Device A but remains logged in on Device B.

positive.title: Log out and ensure session token invalidated
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
2. Click the 'Logout' button.
3. Attempt to access a protected page (e.g., dashboard) after logging out.
positive.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page when trying to access the protected page after logging out.

positive.title: Log out and verify the redirection to the login page
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
2. Click the 'Logout' button.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.

positive.title: Log out and login again with the same credentials
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
2. Click the 'Logout' button.
3. Log in again with the same email and password.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged in again with the same credentials.

negative.title: Log out without logging in using the API endpoint
steps: 1. Send a logout request to the API endpoint without being logged in.
negative.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page or receives an error message.

negative.title: Log out with an expired session token
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
2. Wait for the session token to expire.
3. Click the 'Logout' button.
negative.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page or receives an error message.

negative.title: Log out several times in a row
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
2. Click the 'Logout' button.
3. Click the 'Logout' button again.
negative.expected_result: User is successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.

edge.title: Log out after a long period of inactivity
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
2. Wait for a long period of inactivity (e.g., 30 minutes).
3. Click the 'Logout' button.
edge.expected_result: User is successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.

edge.title: Log out while the network connection is unstable
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
2. Simulate an unstable network connection (e.g., by disconnecting and reconnecting to the internet).
3. Click the 'Logout' button during the unstable connection.
edge.expected_result: User is successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.

edge.title: Log out and try logging in again with the session token
steps: 1. Log in with valid email and password.
2. Click the 'Logout' button.
3. Attempt to log in again using the same session token.
edge.expected_result: User is not able to log in with the expired session token and is redirected to the login page.

edge.title: Login with the same user account from multiple devices and log out from one device
steps: 1. Log in to the account on Device A with valid email and password.
2. Log in to the same account on Device B with valid email and password.
3. Click the 'Logout' button on Device A.
edge.expected_result: User is logged out from Device A and Device B.
